assumptions.author: Iman
assumptions.rationale: PLACEHOLDER. No structural closure data exists in the dataset; the only polygons are administrative licence boundaries (median 268 km2). This range is a generic Po-valley closure scale for pipeline testing and is NOT a site estimate.

assumptions.author: Iman
assumptions.rationale: PLACEHOLDER net storage thickness. Sources give only gross chronostratigraphic intervals (91-2557 m), which are 20-50x too large to use directly. Net-to-gross is unavailable.

assumptions.author: Iman
assumptions.rationale: PLACEHOLDER. Logs record porosity only as qualitative type codes (PK/PI/PV/PC/PF); no numeric porosity exists in any source.

assumptions.author: Iman
assumptions.rationale: PLACEHOLDER. No measured pressure in any source. Range corresponds to hydrostatic at pilot depths; a real run needs RFT/DST data.

assumptions.rationale: Engineering assumption by definition; nothing in the source data constrains E.
